<function name="SetAutoStretchVertical" parent="DLabel" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Automatically adjusts the height of the label dependent of the height of the text inside of it.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="stretch" type="boolean">Whenever to stretch the label vertically or not.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
